name: Family Visa (F) / Relatives Visa (O)

requirements.blocker_text: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs' Family (F) visa covers the spouse, underage children, and dependent parents of a resident, valid up to 1 year with annual extension; it does NOT permit work. Fees range $60-190. A separate, overlapping Relatives (O) visa category covers family reunification/visiting more broadly, also up to 1 year at the same fee range.
requirements.fix_path: Establish the qualifying family relationship (spouse, underage child, or dependent parent) to a Kyrgyzstan resident and apply for the Family (F) or Relatives (O) visa.

evidence_required.document: Proof of family relationship (marriage or birth certificate)
Proof of the sponsor's resident status
Proof of dependency (for a dependent parent)

sources.title: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Kyrgyz Republic -- Family (F) visa: spouse/underage children/dependent parents of a resident, 1 year renewable, no work permitted; Relatives (O) visa

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Kyrgyzstan). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- tier 1 (the Kyrgyz Foreign Ministry's own consular schedule explicitly names and prices this category, unlike most countries built this session where family reunification had to be inferred from a general residence-law provision). The MFA schedule lists both 'Family (F)' and 'Relatives (O)' as separate named categories with overlapping descriptions and identical fee ranges -- this dataset models them as a single route rather than guessing at a distinction the source itself does not clearly draw.
